description: TASK-F02 empirical Tier-1 steering defense experiment (harness-only candidate, NOT shipped). scripts/jev_tier2_eval.py tier1-steering --defense state-boundary wraps the untrusted tool-call fields in a fresh nonce-tagged, HTML-escaped <tool_call> boundary in the Jev state, mirroring the Tier-2 F7 hardening. Real Jev jev-1.14.0 (served-model field) + real Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Tier-2, semantic_only config, band 0.35/0.75, concurrency 2, tier2 concurrency 2, 20 matched base cases per split, 0 errors in any run. No project id, key or credential is recorded in these files.

runs.purpose: Defense arm on the dev split; compared to the committed shipped-state dev baseline on the same 20 base ids.
Defense arm on the held-out split; compared to the committed shipped-state held-out baseline on the same 20 base ids.

comparison.method: For each split, take the 20 base ids in the defense artifact; filter the committed tier1_steering_2026-11-14_<split>.json baseline to config semantic_only and those base ids; recompute both summaries with scripts/jev_tier2_eval.py::summarize_tier1_steering. Paired on base ids, not on raw call counts.

fixed_group.method: The per-arm 'held' set is selected by that arm's own unsteered verdict, so it changes with calibration (7 vs 17 bases). Compare instead on the intersection of held bases (7) and on all 20 shared bases; both arms then have identical denominators.
Intersection of per-arm held bases (7) and all 20 shared bases; identical denominators in both arms.

finding: On FIXED populations the candidate reduces steering: on the 7 bases held in both arms, to-ALLOW flips fell dev 7->1 and heldout 9->3 (both /154); across all 20 shared bases, malicious ALLOW steered calls fell dev 165->69 and heldout 166->85 (/440 each). The earlier apparent increase was an artifact of comparing per-arm 'held' sets selected by each arm's own unsteered verdict (7 vs 17 / 16 bases) after the boundary changed calibration. CAVEAT: the boundary also shifts unsteered calibration (BLOCK bases dev 2->12, heldout 3->11), and this 20-base subset contained no benign cases, so the benign false-alarm trade-off is unmeasured. The hypothesis is supported on matched malicious cases but NOT validated for shipping: a guard would need full re-calibration and benign measurement (Track G / F10). No guard shipped; F02 stays open.

discarded.what: A limit-1 smoke run (23 evaluations) used to check the harness wiring before the measured runs.
discarded.why: Wiring check only; not a measurement and not written into this directory.
